the deconvolution of the TLD-600 glow-curves using general expressions derived by the one-trap, one recombination (OTOR) model gives different results from the case of the other TL expressions.
a new method has been developed to analyze the TL glow-curves of TLD- 600 dosimeters following alpha particles irradiations and that the results are different from the usual analysis.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the improvement of the accuracy of the dose measurements using the deconvolution method and the understanding of the thermally stimulated luminescence mechanism in TLD-600.

a new approach for the analysis of the glow-curves of TLD-100 and TLD-600 following alpha particles irradiations and it is expected that this new method can be applied to other thermoluminescent materials.
the development of a new method of analyzing the TL glow-curves of TLD- 600 following Am-241 α particles irradiation.

the glow-curve of alpha particles-irradiated TLD-600 can be analyzed using the OTOR model and that the kinetic parameters of each peak are dose-dependent and can be determined with high accuracy using the proposed algorithm.
, the OTOR expressions are more suitable for analyzing TLD glow-curves than the other expressions, especially in the case of alpha-particles irradiation.
the OTOR model is the best model to describe the TL kinetics of TLD- 600 dosimeters following alpha particles irradiations.
